compare.title: Living room at spawn
compare.caption: Night, game paused. The real game on the left, the port on the right: geometry, camera, furniture and walls match. Only a flat night ambient (x0.8) is applied; the light patch outside the door and the falloff are still missing.

compare.title: Character moved (held-out frame)
compare.caption: A second oracle: the character walked a few tiles, position read from the save. The camera and the wall cutaway rule were checked on this frame without tuning; the ambient factor was chosen on frame 1 and confirmed here by a sweep (27.1 to 26.1). Most of the remaining difference is lighting.

compare.title: Third position (does not match yet)
compare.caption: A new run of the real game, character one step south of the spawn (position read from the save). The camera and room geometry still line up, but the real game cuts away the south-west wall and shows the next room (a fridge) through it, while the port draws the whole wall and only the player's room. The visibility rule fitted on two frames does not carry over; this frame is kept on purpose.

compare.title: Before: without the visibility mask
compare.caption: The same frame before the visibility mask: the port drew the whole house and yard, while the game shows only the player's room. Difference from the game was 79.7 of 255, now 15.2.
